environment.cache_location: project tmp/ on the Windows-mounted project volume

scope: Historical dividend-adjusted prices for distinct uncached stock/date pairs. Existing raw caches and canonical reports were not changed.
limits: Small samples, mixed companies and different historical periods. Network/provider load varies. These measurements do not establish a universal optimum or a matched-period speedup.

prototype.note: Distinct uncached currently-listed stocks with pre-2018 annual records. No source cache changes. Cold pool per case. No retries. One-year adjusted history. Two reversed-order rounds; urllib baseline is separate.

selected_policy.writer: one owner thread, completed window receipts persisted
selected_policy.429: shared Retry-After cooldown and lower start rate

decision: Eight workers beat four and sixteen in the unpaced transport samples. The paced production test saved 16 histories in 6.56 seconds with 16 HTTP 200 responses and no retry; its different-period serial reference sampled 16 histories in 42.47 seconds. Larger price windows reduce request count below the observed 5000-row cap. Treasury probe was empty, so retain proven monthly windows.
